thread:
Emily Chan: Heads-up — Origami deck (enterprise ed-tech) wants a short POC. They sent a custom variant 'origami-35b-adapt' with an altered tokenizer and a modified KV layout. Need: (1) compatibility check with our catalog, (2) edge pricing estimate for dedicated capacity for a 2-week POC (~5k req/day), (3) answers for parts of their security questionnaire (KMS + data residency). Any immediate blockers? @Ashwin
Ashwin Rao: quick scan — model looks Llama-like but the tokenizer change could break our batching + continuous KV assumptions. Can you drop the model artifact link and tokenizer config? Also: do they expect a quantized variant? If yes, we need to validate our q4 path.
Emily Chan: link + sample tokenizer attached: https://uploads.origami.co/models/origami-35b-adapt.tar.gz
Sample tokenizer snippet: ```tokens.json {"special_tokens": ["<USR>", "<SYS>"]}```
They said they'd accept 8-bit or q4.
Nina Park: security Q — they want to confirm support for customer-managed KMS and EU data residency for the POC. We can offer VPC/private deploy for data residency but lead time is ~2 weeks. Also need to know where logs/metrics live. @Kai any objections on operations side?
Kai Morales: dedicated pool is doable but we need a short commitment spike. Baseline for safe perf: 2x A100s for steady 5k req/day with medium-length prompts. Rough cost: ~$6k/day for the reserved+burst config for 2 A100s (ballpark). If they go q4 we can reduce to ~3.5k/day. Tokenizer mismatch could affect batching efficiency and latency — recommend we run tokenizer normalization at ingress if necessary.
Ashwin Rao: ops checklist I'd run: 1) tokenizer test harness vs their tokens.json 2) KV cache compatibility test (small sampled runs) 3) quantization smoke (q4 path) 4) license check (model license). I can take 1+2 today if Emily provides access and creds.
Emily Chan: creds shared: svc-origami-poc (exp in 48h). Also uploaded their partial security questionnaire (see doc). Can we reply with timeline + pricing options by EOD?
ops-bot: Received request -> ticket created #P-4821 for tokenizer + KV tests. Assigned to Ashwin Rao. Target ETA: 2024-08-03.
Kai Morales: if tokenizer test fails, fallback plan: implement a lightweight pre-token mapping in the request pipeline (canonicalize tokens to our tokenizer) — this is a quick patch but adds ~5-8ms p99 to tokenization step. Better than delaying the POC.
Nina Park: legal flagged a question about third-party training data disclosures in their questionnaire. I'll escalate to Legal and will need the full model license + dataset disclosure from Origami. ETA 24-48h for us to get back on legal.
Emily Chan: perfect — Ashwin please ping here when tests complete. I'll prepare three pricing options: hosted trial (limited tokens), dedicated 2-week with reserved capacity, and private deploy (if they need EU residency). Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
thread_summary: POC coordination for Origami's custom 'origami-35b-adapt' model: tokenizer and KV compatibility tests, quantization validation, pricing estimates for dedicated capacity vs q4 savings, security/KMS and data residency questions, legal/license escalation, ops ticket created.
